 tripurastarnews30 
 November 14, 2026 
 Spread the love 
 Mumbai, Maharashtra, 14th of November, 2026 : Veteran actors Anil Kapoor and Shatrughan Sinha are neighbours, and their association in Hindi cinema goes back to the 1980s, when both appeared in Yudh. On Star Plus’ India Ke Top 1% – The Anil Kapoor Show, Kapoor spoke warmly about their friendship and said he takes pride in having Sinha as his neighbour.
 The conversation came up during the Great Indian Budhi League special when Bihar’s Lalmani Srivastav introduced himself as the happiest man in the world and said people from his state are always happy. Kapoor replied with the saying, “Jo na kate aari se, woh kate Bihari se,” before praising Bihar’s talent and bringing up Sinha, who also hails from the state.
 “Mere padosi hain Shatrughan Sinha sahab, woh Bihar se hain. Main unki bahut izzat karta hoon. Bahut badhiya insaan hain aur main dil se unko chahta hoon. In fact, woh doston ke dost hain Shatrughan sahab aur mujhe garv hai ki woh mere padosi hain.”
 Watch India Ke Top 1% – The Anil Kapoor Show every Saturday and Sunday at 8 PM on Star Plus and JioHotstar.
